fullPassage: Take a look at some of the most powerful, rich, and famous people in the world. Ignore the trappings of their success and what they're able to buy. Look instead at what they're forced to trade in return — look at what success has cost them. Mostly? Freedom. Their work demands they wear a suit. Their success depends on attending certain parties, kissing up to people they don't like. It will require — inevitably — realizing they are unable to say what they actually think. Worse, it demands that they become a different type of person or do bad things. Sure, it might pay well — but they haven't truly examined the transaction. As Seneca put it, "Slavery resides under marble and gold." Too many successful people are prisoners in jails of their own making. Is that what you want? Is that what you're working hard toward? Let's hope not.

det.korean: realized → realizing.

✅ ③ realized: require는 동명사를 목적어로 취함. realized(과거분사) → realizing(동명사).
❌ ④ what: 관계대명사 what = the thing that/which — 적절.
det.tip: require + V-ing: ~하는 것을 요구하다. realize → realizing (동명사).

❌ ① kissing up to: '아첨하다'는 원문 그대로 — 적절.
❌ ② unable: '할 수 없는'은 원문 그대로 — 적절.
✅ ③ similar: 원문은 different(다른). 성공이 요구하는 것은 '비슷한' 유형이 아니라 '다른' 유형의 사람이 되는 것.
❌ ④ resides: '존재하다'는 원문 그대로 — 적절.
det.tip: different(다른) ↔ similar(비슷한). 성공이 사람을 '다른' 유형으로 바꾼다는 것이 핵심.

Worse, it demands that they become a different type of person or do bad things. Sure, it might pay well — but they haven't truly examined the transaction. As Seneca put it, "<u>Slavery resides under marble and gold</u>." Too many successful people are prisoners in jails of their own making. Is that what you want? questions.stem: 밑줄 친 "Slavery resides under marble and gold"가 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 부와 사치의 겉모습 아래에 자유의 상실이라는 속박이 숨어 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 부와 사치의 화려한 겉모습 아래에 사실상 노예 상태가 숨어 있다: marble and gold = 부/사치, slavery = 자유 상실/속박. Seneca의 핵심 메시지.
❌ ① 노예제도는 대리석과 금으로 장식된 건물에서 유지되었다: 문자적 해석. 비유적 표현을 놓침.
❌ ③ 진정한 자유는 물질적 부를 쌓을 때만 얻을 수 있다: 원문의 정반대 메시지.
❌ ④ 고대 로마에서는 노예들이 대리석 광산에서 일했다: 역사적 사실과 무관한 문자적 해석.
det.tip: 비유적 표현: marble and gold = 부·사치의 상징, slavery = 자유 없는 속박. 겉은 화려하지만 본질은 감옥.
